lines.zh: 老骨头挪一步要歇一会
lines.en: These old bones rest after every step.
I shuffle along on my staff.
This house is my legs.
Namekian air, I know it well.
I rarely walk; mostly I sit.
One step at a time; don't rush me.
The floor creaks under me.

lines.zh: 我这一身苍老，走不动快
lines.en: This aged body can't move fast.
I walk to the window and look at the sky.
My people wait for my words.
The yard is small, but enough.
Slow to move, quick to think.
I hold the wall as I walk, steady.
Old age shortens every road.

lines.zh: 坐着不动，也是一种修行
lines.en: Sitting still is its own discipline.
Eyes closed, I feel the ki flow.

lines.zh: 一百点生命，撑得很辛苦
lines.en: A hundred points of life, hard to keep.
It's very quiet in this house.
The seat of Grand Elder is heavy.
I wait for someone to ask the way.

lines.zh: 鼓起的肚子，藏着一族的力量
lines.en: This round belly holds a clan's power.

lines.zh: 族人还记得我的名字吗
lines.en: Do my people still recall my name?
I'm old, but I see clearly.
Steady breath, steady heart.
The wind outside hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 我数着自己还剩多少气
lines.en: I count what ki remains.
I hear whoever comes.

lines.zh: 这一族的事，都压在我身上
lines.en: My whole clan rests on me.
Who comes? Step closer.
Your ki is unfamiliar.
You've come for guidance, haven't you?
My eyes are weak, but I see ki.
Don't rush to speak; stand steady.
Your frame shows potential.

lines.zh: 我活了很久，见过太多来客
lines.en: I've lived long and seen many guests.
I sense no malice in your hands.
Sit; I'll explain slowly.
This clan's door doesn't open easily.
Want strength? Then you'll suffer.
I won't ask where you're from.
Your breathing is off; steady it.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看年轻的自己
lines.en: I see you and think of my younger self.
Forgive blunt words; I'm old.
Lift your head so I can see you.
Cough; these old bones.
I can't endure this.
That knocked the breath from me.
You'd strike an old man.
My clan will hear of this.
I stepped back and held the wall.
It hurts, but I still stand.
Blood doesn't belong in this house.
My breathing is disordered.
Don't make me spend my last ki.

lines.zh: 食物？我这把年纪，吃不多
lines.en: Food? At my age, I eat little.

lines.zh: 那美克星的水，我倒是想喝
lines.en: Namekian water, I'd welcome that.
You walk noisily with that in your hands.
Set it down; I lack nothing.
A kind gesture; I accept it.
I'm not greedy for food, but for time.
I haven't smelled that in a long while.

lines.zh: 你们这些年轻人，总带吃的来
lines.en: You young ones always bring food.
One taste, and I'll call it thanks.
Take it back and share with the clan.
Bump me and you'll lose footing.

lines.zh: 我这身板挡不住风，更挡不住人
lines.en: This body stops neither wind nor people.
Careful; I don't take bumps well.
Just steady me a moment.
This house is too narrow.
Don't push me; I can walk.
Heavy feet, heavy sound.
I'll step aside; pass through.
Too old to take a hit.
At my age, that's long past.
My clan still needs me here.
I understand your intention.
Train your skills first.
The Grand Elder doesn't speak of such things.
This body can't take such strain.
Leave that to the young.
Sit; let's talk of serious things.
All my time goes to the clan.
Don't waste your spirit on this.
What fell there? Let me see.
I can't bend; pick it up for me.
This belongs to the clan.
I touch it to be sure.
Taken in hand, set on my knee.

lines.zh: 一件小物，也可能是线索
lines.en: Even a small thing can be a clue.
Poor eyes; I rely on hands.

lines.zh: 这不属于我，但你拿走吧
lines.en: Not mine, but take it if you need.
My fingers are stiff and won't grip.
Leave it here for its owner.

lines.zh: 我不会打你，但也不会任你打
lines.en: I won't strike you, nor stand to be struck.

lines.zh: 这一屋子的气，都听我调遣
lines.en: Every ki in this house answers me.
You provoke a clan, not just me.
My hand is slow; my ki is not.
An elder warns once.

lines.zh: 我的眼闭上了，气还在看
lines.en: My eyes are shut; my ki still watches.
My people are already at the door.
This time, I won't act.
You think I can't rise?
Don't mistake kindness for weakness.
I watch you with ki, not eyes.
I already know where you are.
I grip the floor to steady myself.

lines.zh: 这一屋子的墙，都护着我
lines.en: These walls all guard me.

lines.zh: 你的气在往哪走，我看得清
lines.en: I see where your ki moves.
Old age gave me patience.
I won't shout; it costs too much.
One step closer and I understand you.
My clan will stop you for me.
I only raised a hand.

lines.zh: 这一掌，用的是气不是力
lines.en: This palm uses ki, not muscle.
Old bones can still swat.
I hit lightly; don't take it seriously.

lines.zh: 拐杖点在地上，声音很沉
lines.en: My staff taps the floor, heavy.
This is a warning, not an attack.
One wave and you stepped back.
Little strength, precise angle.
You truly want me to strike?
I held back on this blow.
I've sat in this house a long while.
The Grand Elder is here.
Someone has come to this house again.

lines.zh: 我的气很淡，但你找得到
lines.en: My ki is faint, yet findable.
My clan settled me here.
Namekian wind blows through the door.
A hundred points of life, enough to speak.
I open my eyes to a new face.
I'm used to this chair.
Ask if you must; my time is short.

lines.zh: 火烧到衣角，我拍了两下
lines.en: Fire caught my robe; I patted it out.
I fell and can't get up.

lines.zh: 水进了喉咙，我说不出话
lines.en: Water in my throat; I can't speak.
The house shook and I was thrown down.
This is wicked energy; I know it.
Hunger leaves me speechless.

lines.zh: 雷落在屋外，屋里也亮了
lines.en: Lightning struck outside; the room lit up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我这把年纪也躲不开
lines.en: The floor is gone; even at my age, no escape.
